SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ____
S.I., Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date April 15, 1935.

Subject District Messenger Service - proposed establishment of

Made by D.S. Hide    Forwarded by C. Crawford D.

On April 10th 1935, Mr. Boris Blessarovich
PETRENCO, residing at Apartment 61, House 3, Lane 15,
Carter Road (Tel. 39135) called at Police Headquarters
and requested information regarding the formalities,
if any, attendant upon the establishment of a District
Messenger Service based on lines similar to those
existing in other large cities.

The following details regarding the proposed
concern, which will take the form of a private company
with an initial capital of $25,000.00, were furnished
by the applicant.

Four Service Stations will be established, one
in each of the Eastern, Central and Western Districts
and one in the French Concession. Each Station will
be in charge of a foreign female operator and ten
bicycle messenger boys will be attached thereto.
Should the project prove successful the number of
stations will be increased from time to time.
The business of the concern will consist of the
transmission of messages, the purchase and delivery
of orders for flowers, chocolates and goods in
general, the purchase and reservation of theatre
tickets, the settlement of client's accounts and any
other services of a similar nature.

The applicant states he is desirous of
securing an official monopoly of this particular
line of business for a period of two years.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号 ____
S.I.，特别分站，
报告
日期：1935年4月15日。

事由：区域信差服务——拟设立

制作人：D.S. Hide    转呈人：C. Crawford D.

1935年4月10日，鲍里斯·布莱萨罗维奇·佩特连科（Boris Blessarovich PETRENCO）先生，住址为卡特路（Carter Road）15弄3号61室（电话：39135），前往警察总局，咨询关于设立区域信差服务的相关手续（如有），该服务拟参照其他大城市现有的模式运作。

申请人提供了关于该拟议企业的以下详情，该企业将采取私营公司形式，初始资本为25,000.00美元。

将设立四个服务站，东区、中区和西区各设一个，法租界设一个。每个服务站将由一名外籍女性接线员负责，并配备十名自行车信差童工。若该项目证明成功，服务站的数量将不时增加。
该公司的业务包括传递信件、代购及递送鲜花、巧克力及一般商品的订单、代购及预留戏票、结算客户账目以及任何其他类似性质的服务。

申请人表示，希望获得为期两年的此类特定业务的官方垄断权。

The applicant was born of Russian parents in
Vladivostok on January 20th 1898. He arrived in
Shanghai in 1923 and was subsequently employed in
the building and motor trade. From April 15th 1937
until December 31st 1938 he was employed by the
Shanghai Power Company and is in possession of an
excellent letter of recommendation regarding his
character and ability. He is also in possession of
a letter of recommendation signed by Mr. S. METZLER,
Chairman of the Russian Emigrants' Committee.
The files of the Shanghai and French Municipal
Police contain nothing to the detriment of the
applicant.

June 14, 1939.

TAIRIKU SHIMPO

"FRENCH AUTHORITIES STRICTLY PROHIBIT MEETINGS
IN SCHOOLS"

In compliance with our request,
the French authorities have decided to suppress political
activities in the French Concession. Consequently no
students may hold meetings in their schools. The French
authorities are said to have notified the public that
this measure is aimed to maintain peace and order. Since
the trouble over flag hoisting Chinese students circles
in the French Concession are reported to have begun to
adopt an attitude of opposition towards the French Municipal
Council.
page_data.zh:
1939年6月14日。

《大陆新报》（TAIRIKU SHIMPO）

“法国当局严禁在学校内集会”

应我方要求，法国当局已决定取缔法租界内的政治活动。因此，学生不得在校内举行集会。据称，法国当局已通告公众，此举旨在维持和平与秩序。自升旗风波以来，据报道，法租界内的中国学生团体已开始对公董局采取反对态度。
